_comment: Width allowances (px, FONT_NORMAL) for batch ui-a (menus/UI/system strings). Each value verified against the window template / print call cited in the matching _why entry.
_why src/battle_controller_player.c:2023: B_SHOW_PARTNER_TARGET: 'Partner will use:\n' + move name printed with BattlePutTextOnWindow(gStringVar1, B_WIN_ACTION_PROMPT); battle_bg.c B_WIN_ACTION_PROMPT width 14 tiles = 112 px, text template x=1, FONT_NORMAL -> 111 px; 104 keeps a margin.
_why src/field_specials.c:sText_BigGuy,s: GetPlayerBigGuyGirlString / GetRivalSonDaughterString StringCopy into gStringVar1; the validator measures {STR_VAR_1} as 10 chars = 60 px in the messages that use it.
_why src/field_specials.c:sText_1MinuteP: DetermineCyclingRoadResults copies it into gStringVar2, shown in Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary ('… … {STR_VAR_2}!' ~25 px) and Route110_Text_BestRecord ('Tempo impiegato: {STR_VAR_2}' ~85 px) in the 216-px field message box: 84 px fits both.
_why src/field_specials.c:sScrollableMul: ShowScrollableMultichoice (Task_ShowScrollableMultichoice): tWidth = ConvertPixelWidthToTileWidth(widest item), window at tLeft = 1 with no side panel for this list (FillFrontierExchangeCornerWindowAndItemIcon / ShowBattleFrontierTutorWindow only act on the Frontier lists), so the window simply grows: 100 px -> 14 tiles from x=1.
_why src/follower_helper.c: follower messages: GetFollowerAction loads the text into the script context and runs EventScript_FollowerGeneric / EventScript_FollowerJump etc. (data/scripts/follower.inc): 'message 0x0; waitmessage; waitbuttonpress' on the standard field message box (sStandardTextBox_WindowTemplates, 27 tiles = 216 px, x=0, 2 lines); 208 keeps an 8-px margin. {STR_VAR_1} (follower nickname) is measured as 60 px by the validator.
_why src/pokedex_plus_hgss.c:sText_Stats: PrintStatsScreen_Left: second-column label drawn with PrintStatsScreenTextSmall (font 0 = FONT_SMALL) at x = base_x + base_x_second_row = 51, value at base_x + base_x_offset = 78 -> 27 px; 'AtSp'/'DfSp' are 20 px in FONT_SMALL (24 px FONT_NORMAL).
PrintStatsScreen_Moves_Top: FONT_SMALL at x = moves_x + 113 = 118 in WIN_STATS_MOVES_TOP (18 tiles = 144 px) -> 26 px; 'Liv.' is 19 px.
label at x = base_x = 8 (FONT_SMALL), value at base_x + x_offset_column = 51 -> 43 px available; 'Cattura:' measures 42 px in FONT_SMALL (the font actually used), 44 px in FONT_NORMAL.
catch-rate value: FONT_SMALL at x = 51 in WIN_STATS_LEFT (12 tiles = 96 px) -> 45 px; widest value 'Difficile' is 42 px FONT_SMALL / 46 px FONT_NORMAL.

growth label at x = base_x = 8 (FONT_SMALL), value right-aligned to total_x = 93 (GetStringRightAlignXOffset(0, strEV, 93)) -> label + value <= 83 px FONT_SMALL; 'Cresc.' = 30 px + widest value 'Fluttuante' 50 px = 80 px (original 'GROW: ' 30 + 'FLUCTUATING' 52 = 82).
growth-rate value right-aligned to x = 93 in WIN_STATS_LEFT (FONT_SMALL); original FLUCTUATING is 66 px FONT_NORMAL / 52 px FONT_SMALL, all Italian values <= 50 px FONT_SMALL.

egg groups are printed as sText_Stats_eggGroup_Groups '{STR_VAR_1}/{STR_VAR_2}' with FONT_SMALL at x = 8 in WIN_STATS_LEFT (96 px) -> 88 px for the pair; worst Italian pairs ('Coleott./Umanoide', 'Umanoide/Minerale') are 84 px FONT_SMALL; single names <= 46 px FONT_NORMAL.
unused: these symbols are only defined in pokedex_plus_hgss.c and never referenced (grep), so no window constrains them; kept short anyway.
_why src/pokedex_plus_hgss.c:sText_EVO_B: EvoFormsPage_PrintNavigationButtons: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(WIN_NAVIGATION_BUTTONS, font 0 = FONT_SMALL, x + 9 = 15, ...); sInfoScreen_WindowTemplates[WIN_NAVIGATION_BUTTONS] width 20 tiles = 160 px -> 145 px.
_why src/pokedex_plus_hgss.c:sText_FORMS: same navigation window (20 tiles = 160 px), FONT_SMALL at x = 6 -> 154 px.
_why src/pokedex_plus_hgss.c:PrintEvolut: evolution-method fragments are concatenated into gStringVar4, then fontId = GetFontIdToFit(gStringVar4, FONT_SMALL, 0, maxScreenWidth) and BreakStringAutomatic(gStringVar4, maxScreenWidth, MAX_EVO_METHOD_LINES = 10, ...) wrap them to the available width, so no fragment has a fixed limit.
_why src/item_menu.c:sText_Var1CantBeHel: DisplayItemMessage(taskId, FONT_NORMAL, ...) -> ITEMWIN_MESSAGE (sContextMenuWindowTemplates, 27 tiles = 216 px, x=0, 2 lines); 208 keeps room for the continue arrow.
_why src/item_menu.c:sText_DepositHowMan: BagMenu_Print(WIN_DESCRIPTION, FONT_NORMAL, str, x=3, ...): sDefaultBagWindows[WIN_DESCRIPTION] width 14 tiles = 112 px -> 109 px; the item name in gStringVar1 is shrunk with WrapFontIdToFit(..., WindowWidthPx(WIN_DESCRIPTION) - 16).
_why src/item_menu.c:sText_DepositedVar2: same WIN_DESCRIPTION (109 px at x=3), but {STR_VAR_2} is the deposited quantity, ConvertIntToDecimalStringN(..., MAX_ITEM_DIGITS = 3) -> at most 18 px instead of the 60 px the validator assumes: 'Hai depositato 999' = 98 px.
_why src/item_menu.c:sItemMenuActions: PrintContextMenuItems / PrintContextMenuItemGrid: FONT_NARROW at x=8 in 7-tile (56 px) windows or 56-px grid columns (ITEMWIN_1x1/1x2/2x2/2x3) -> 48 px FONT_NARROW; widest Italian action 'Etichetta' = 44 px narrow (52 px normal), 'Quantità' 39 px narrow.
_why src/item_menu.c:sSortTypeStrings: copied into gStringVar1 for sText_ItemsSorted ('Strumenti ordinati per {STR_VAR_1}!'), whose check measures {STR_VAR_1} as 60 px.

_why src/landmark.c: PrintLandmarkNames (pokenav_region_map.c): AddTextPrinterParameterized(infoWindowId, FONT_NARROW, name, x=0, ...) on sMapSecInfoWindowTemplate (12 tiles = 96 px). The real limit is 96 px in FONT_NARROW: every Italian name measures <= 96 px FONT_NARROW (widest 'Ostello della Nonnina' 96, 'Casa del Cercatesori' 94); 117 px FONT_NORMAL is the original widest name ('FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE', 97 px narrow).
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_SaveFileCorru: CreateMainMenuErrorWindow prints on window 7 = sWindowTemplates_MainMenu[7] (MENU_WIDTH_ERROR 26 tiles = 208 px, height 4 = 2 lines), FONT_NORMAL at x=0.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_BatteryRunDry: CreateMainMenuErrorWindow, window 7 = 26 tiles = 208 px, x=0, FONT_NORMAL; text has a \p so 8 px are kept for the down arrow.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_MainMenuNewGa: main menu headers: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(n, FONT_NORMAL, x=0, ...) on sWindowTemplates_MainMenu[0..6], all MENU_WIDTH = 26 tiles = 208 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuP: MainMenu_FormatSavegamePlayer: label at x=0, player name (PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH 7, <= 48 px) right-aligned to x=100 in window 2 -> label must end before ~52 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuT: MainMenu_FormatSavegameTime: label at x=0x6C=108, play time 'hhh:mm' (<= 36 px) right-aligned to x=0xD0=208 -> label <= 64 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuB: MainMenu_FormatSavegameBadges: label at x=108, one-digit badge count right-aligned to x=208 -> label <= 92 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:sMalePresetNames,sr: preset player names copied into gSaveBlock2Ptr->playerName (PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH = 7 chars); same 7 x 6 px rule the validator uses for name fields; all names <= 7 chars.
_why src/mystery_event_msg.c: mystery event result messages: mystery_event_menu.c prints gStringVar4 with PrintMysteryMenuText(WIN_MSG, str, x=1, ...); sWindowTemplates[WIN_MSG] is 22 tiles = 176 px -> 175 px, 2 lines.
_why src/mystery_event_msg.c:gText_Myste: same WIN_MSG (175 px) but {STR_VAR_1}/{STR_VAR_2} are berry names (BERRY_NAME_LENGTH = 6 chars, <= 36 px) instead of the 60 px the validator assumes: real width of the first line is 173 px.
_why src/naming_screen.c:sText_RivalsNam: DrawNormalTextEntryBox: AddTextPrinterParameterized(WIN_TEXT_ENTRY_BOX, FONT_NORMAL, title, x=8, ...); sWindowTemplates[WIN_TEXT_ENTRY_BOX] width 17 tiles = 136 px -> 128 px.
_why src/naming_screen.c:sText_MoveOkBac: PrintControls: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(WIN_BANNER, FONT_SMALL, x=2, ...); sWindowTemplates[WIN_BANNER] width DISPLAY_TILE_WIDTH = 30 tiles = 240 px.
_why src/pokemon.c:gNaturesInfo: nature names: use_pokeblock.c WIN_NATURE (11 tiles = 88 px, FONT_NORMAL at x=2) prints 'Natura/' (38 px) + name -> 48 px; summary memo (PSS_DATA_WINDOW_INFO_MEMO, 18 tiles = 144 px) prints 'Natura <name>,' -> far below 144. Widest Italian nature ('Birbona', 'Ingenua', 'Modesta') is 42 px.
_why src/battle_controller_oak_old_man.c: Oak tutorial texts: BattlePutTextOnWindow(gDisplayedStringBattle, B_WIN_OAK_OLD_MAN); battle_bg.c B_WIN_OAK_OLD_MAN is 26 tiles = 208 px (same as B_WIN_MSG); 200 keeps room for the \p down arrow.
printed in B_WIN_ACTION_PROMPT (battle_bg.c, 14 tiles = 112 px, text template x=1) like gText_WhatWillPkmnDo.
_why src/option_menu.c:gText_Option: DrawHeaderText: FONT_NORMAL at x=8 on WIN_HEADER (sOptionMenuWinTemplates, 26 tiles = 208 px).
_why src/option_menu.c:sOptionMenuItemsN: DrawOptionMenuTexts: FONT_NORMAL at x=8 on WIN_OPTIONS (26 tiles); the value column starts at x=104 (DrawOptionMenuChoice(..., 104, ...)) -> 96 px, 4 px kept as gap. Widest Italian name 'Animazioni lotta' = 85 px.
_why src/option_menu.c:gText_TextSpeedSl: TextSpeed_DrawChoices: slow at x=104, fast right-aligned to x=198, mid centred between them -> the three values share 94 px; Bassa 30 + Media 28 + Alta 22 = 80 px leaves 7-px gaps (original 24+18+24).

_why src/option_menu.c:gText_BattleStyle: BattleStyle_DrawChoices: first value at x=104, second right-aligned to x=198 -> 94 px for both; 'Scegli' 32 + 'Fisso' 28 = 60 px.
_why src/data/party_menu.h:sActionString: DisplayPartyMenuStdMessage -> PrintMessage on WIN_MSG (28 tiles = 224 px in every sPartyMenu window set), FONT_NORMAL, x=0.
_why src/data/party_menu.h:sCursorOption: DisplaySelectionWindow(SELECTWINDOW_ACTIONS): SetWindowTemplateFields(..., width 10 tiles = 80 px), text at x = GetMenuCursorDimensionByFont(FONT_NORMAL, 0) = 8 -> 72 px (the same window also holds field-move names).
SELECTWINDOW_ITEM: sItemGiveTakeWindowTemplate width 6 tiles = 48 px, text at x=8 -> 40 px.
SELECTWINDOW_MAIL: sMailReadTakeWindowTemplate width 8 tiles = 64 px, text at x=8 -> 56 px.
SELECTWINDOW_CATALOG: sCatalogSelectWindowTemplate width 12 tiles = 96 px, text at x=8 -> 88 px.
SELECTWINDOW_ZYGARDECUBE: sZygardeCubeSelectWindowTemplate width 11 tiles = 88 px, text at x=8 -> 80 px.
_why src/player_pc.c:sText_WithdrawXItem: ItemStorage_PrintMessage on ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE (sWindowTemplates_ItemStorage, 13 tiles = 104 px, x=0); {STR_VAR_2} is the quantity, ConvertIntToDecimalStringN(..., 3) -> <= 18 px instead of the 60 px the validator assumes: 'Hai ritirato 999' = 82 px; the item name line is shrunk with WrapFontIdToFit(..., WindowWidthPx(ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE) - 6).
_why src/player_pc.c:sItemStorage_Option: ItemStorageMenuPrint: AddTextPrinterParameterized(0, FONT_NORMAL, text, x=0, ...) on window 0 = field message box (27 tiles = 216 px).

_why src/player_pc.c:sText_Mailbox: Mailbox_DrawMailboxMenu: centred with GetStringCenterAlignXOffset(FONT_NORMAL, str, 0x40) in MAILBOXWIN_TITLE (menu_specialized.c, 8 tiles = 64 px); also a PC menu item (InitPlayerPCMenu: width = GetMaxWidthInSubsetOfMenuTable, grows with the text).
_why src/player_pc.c:sPlayerPCMenuAction: InitPlayerPCMenu: windowTemplate.width = GetMaxWidthInSubsetOfMenuTable(sPlayerPCMenuActions, ...) = ConvertPixelWidthToTileWidth(widest), window at left 1, PrintMenuActionTextsInUpperLeftCorner at x=8 -> grows with the widest item.
_why src/player_pc.c:sText_NoRoomInBag,s: ItemStorage_PrintMessage: AddTextPrinterParameterized(ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE, FONT_NORMAL, ..., x=0); sWindowTemplates_ItemStorage[ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE] is 13 tiles = 104 px, 6 tiles high (3 lines).
_why src/pokeblock.c:gPokeblockNames: pokeblock case list: UpdatePokeblockList sets gMultiuseListMenuTemplate.fontId = FONT_NARROW and PutPokeblockListMenuString appends EXT_CTRL_CODE_SKIP CHAR_BLOCK_1 (x = 87) before the level, so a name must stay under 87 px in FONT_NARROW: all Italian names are <= 81 px narrow ('Pokémella Azzurra'/'Marrone'), 93 px FONT_NORMAL. Elsewhere the name is a {STR_VAR_n} on its own line (sText_ThrowAwayVar1, sText_Var1ThrownAway) or in a 2-line message box.
_why src/pokeblock.c:sText_StowCase: last item of the same FONT_NARROW list: WIN_LIST 14 tiles = 112 px, sPokeblockListMenuTemplate.item_X = 1 -> 111 px; 'Riponi PortaPokémelle.' is 102 px FONT_NARROW (117 px FONT_NORMAL).
_why src/pokeblock.c:DrawPokeblockMenuTi: flavor labels: PrintOnPokeblockWindow(WIN_SPICY..WIN_SOUR, FONT_NORMAL, x=0); each window is 5 tiles = 40 px.
_why src/pokeblock.c:sText_ThrowAwayVar1: DisplayMessageAndContinueTask(taskId, WIN_TOSS_MSG, ..., FONT_NORMAL, ...): sWindowTemplates[WIN_TOSS_MSG] is 27 tiles = 216 px, 2 lines; 208 keeps room for the continue arrow.
_why src/pokedex.c:sText_PokedexRegistra: PrintMonInfo: PrintInfoScreenText(sText_PokedexRegistration, GetStringCenterAlignXOffset(FONT_NORMAL, str, DISPLAY_WIDTH), 0) on window 0 (sInfoScreen_WindowTemplates[WIN_INFO], 32 tiles), centered across the 240-px screen.
_why src/pokedex.c:sText_HTHeight,src/po: PrintMonMeasurements: label at DEX_HEADER_X (96, +59 with HGSS) and value at DEX_MEASUREMENT_X (129, +51 with HGSS) -> 33 px (25 px in the HGSS layout).

_why src/pokenav_main_menu.c:sHelpBarTex: PrintHelpBarText: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(helpBarWindowId, FONT_NORMAL, x=0, ...); sHelpBarWindowTemplate width 16 tiles = 128 px.
_why src/map_name_popup.c:GetPopUpMapNam: ShowMapNamePopUpWindow: with OW_POPUP_GENERATION = GEN_5 (current config) the name is printed in FONT_SHORT at x=8 in a 30-tile window (AddMapNamePopUpWindow, menu.c); with the Gen 3 popup fontId = GetFontIdToFit(name, FONT_NORMAL, -1, 80) then centred in 80 px, so a wider name drops to FONT_NARROW; 'Centro Azzurrop.' is 76 px narrow (87 normal). 16 chars + the floor suffix fits the 21-byte name part of mapDisplayHeader[MAP_POPUP_STRING_BUFFER_LENGTH = 27] (prefix 6).
_why src/map_name_popup.c:sBattlePyramid: Battle Pyramid popup names use the same ShowMapNamePopUpWindow paths (GEN_5: FONT_SHORT at x=8 in the 30-tile window; Gen 3: GetFontIdToFit(name, FONT_NORMAL, -1, 80) and centred in 80 px); 'Piramide 1º P.' = 70 px.

The Yes/No box (DisplayYesNoMenuDefaultYes) sits above it.
_why src/data/script_menu.h: multichoice lists: DrawMultichoiceMenuInternal / DrawMultichoiceMenuDynamic (script_menu.c) size the window from the widest item: ConvertPixelWidthToTileWidth(w) = (w+9)/8+1 tiles, capped at MAX_MULTICHOICE_WIDTH 28 tiles, and ScriptMenu_AdjustLeftCoordFromWidth shifts the window left to keep it on screen; PrintMenuTable draws at x=8 (cursor). Items up to 207 px fit in the 28-tile cap. Translations were kept much narrower; non-list strings have their own keys below.

_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:sMessa: PrintMessage: AddTextPrinterParameterized(WIN_MESSAGE, FONT_NORMAL, text, x=0, ...); sWindowTemplates[WIN_MESSAGE] width 18 tiles = 144 px, one line.
